hazards.control: Stay clear of flowlines and iron under flow; restraints on temporary lines.
No ignition sources at the tree; grounding on the flowline.

name: Flowline to the facility
function: The buried or surface line from the tree choke to the production facility or gathering header, with its check valve, sensors, and emergency shutdown valve.

tabs.overview: Sized for the expected rate and the flowline pressure; a pressure transmitter and high-low pressure switches trip the wing or the ESD valve; pigging connections where waxes or solids build up.
tabs.engineering: Pipe class per the facility; corrosion inhibition where needed.
tabs.connections: Tree choke outlet; facility inlet header.
tabs.safety: Line of fire under flow; ESD tested.
tabs.evidence: API 6A scope for trees (S1), API Spec 14A for safety valves (S29), API 11D1 for packers (S21), field practice (S9). Photographs read for proportion only.
tabs.operations: Commissioned with the tree; pigged as needed.
tabs.failure_modes: Corrosion, freezing, wax or scale, sensor faults.
